name: Stereolabs ZED 2i
accuracy_notes: Manufacturer nominal exterior envelope and mass; independent approximate enclosure, aperture positions, ports, mounting reference, center of mass and uniform-envelope inertia. No optical calibration, calibrated stereo baseline or simulated depth output. Uses official store dimensions and 230 g mass. Official ZED USB 3 documentation and ZED 2i datasheet Rev 1.2 round the envelope to 175.3 × 30.3 × 43.1 mm and list 229 g. Lens variant, cables and locking connector clearance are not modeled.
status: Reference-informed detailed exterior; unmeasured component geometry
origin_description: Bottom center of total envelope; nominal attachment reference, not a measured mount interface

sources.title: ZED USB 3 hardware specifications; alternative rounded envelope and 229 g mass
